overview.text: 四 means “four.” Its present form encloses inner 儿-form strokes within 囗. Its origin is disputed: it may directly represent four, or have been borrowed from a graph associated with 呬 or 泗; the borrowing proposals remain unproven.

components.text: 囗 forms the enclosing outer shape in the present graph.
儿 identifies the inner strokes in the present graph; their ancient role is unresolved.
